title: VendPoint Start-Up Par Review — Desk Reference and Par Change Entry
content:
## The review

Corbett's start-up par review covers the item most recently added to a machine, which is the item whose add entry on the machine's selection history carries the highest planogram request reference (Corbett issues these references in sequence), for the three months after the date of that add entry: when that item runs empty between two scheduled restock visits, Corbett re-sizes the par of its selection and records a par change entry from Corbett dated the day of the review, which takes effect at the next restock visit like any other selection change; Corbett-initiated changes never count toward the included changes, and the customer may still ask for another par afterwards under the planogram rules.

Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

Any other item, and an item whose add entry is three or more whole months old, counted this way, keeps its par under the planogram rules.

This review belongs to the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program and is Corbett's own act: the par change entry is recorded by Corbett, not asked for by the customer.

### Scope at a glance

| Item | Under the review |
|---|---|
| The item most recently added, fewer than three whole months after its add entry, run empty between two scheduled restock visits | Corbett re-sizes the par of its selection |
| Any other item | Keeps its par under the planogram rules |
| The item most recently added, three or more whole months after its add entry | Keeps its par under the planogram rules |

Hypothetical dates: for an add entry dated 15 January, a review on 14 April is two whole months after it (the 14th is before the 15th), so the item is inside the three months; on 15 April it is three whole months, and the item keeps its par.

## Recording the par change: `resize_selection_par_58ce1bb4`

**Capability.** The tool records a par change made by Corbett on one selection of a VendPoint machine: a new selection history entry sets the par quantity of the named selection and item to the value given, marked as a Corbett change of type par change, dated today and carrying the next planogram request reference in sequence, one above the highest planogram request reference on record. The item's product category and special-item flag are carried over from the existing entries of that selection and item.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls `resize_selection_par_58ce1bb4` with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `vending_machine_id` | The reference number of the VendPoint machine placement whose selection is re-sized, as returned by the machine lookup |
| `slot_label` | The label of the selection (door, coil or bay) exactly as it appears on the machine's selection history entries, copied character for character |
| `sku` | The Corbett item number held in that selection exactly as it appears on the machine's selection history entries, copied character for character |
| `par_qty` | The new par quantity of the selection: a whole number of units, zero or more, with no decimal part |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` with the text `par_changed`, `vending_slot_id` (the new selection history entry), `vending_machine_id`, `slot_label` and `sku` echoed back, `par_qty` (the new par as an integer number of units), `change_reference` (the planogram request reference issued, letters VPC, a hyphen and six digits) and `effective_date` (the date of the entry in YYYY-MM-DD form).
